name: Suraj Desai
player_statement:
A complete player, Suraj Desai has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 45, with an average of 22.00 and a quick strike rate of 122.22. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 12 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 10.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 7.70. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
